_comment: Cross-language TWIN fixture (debt #284). The single arbiter read by BOTH tests/unit/infrastructure/gis/test_twin_section_corridor_membership.py and desktop/src/renderer/src/utils/sectionCorridorMembership.twin.test.ts. It pins the section-corridor membership rule (lateral buffer AND the along-span between the drawn endpoints, with a 1 micron endpoint tolerance) shared by section_projection.py (project_onto_section_corridor) and sectionProjection.ts (investigationsOnSection). on_section is asserted strictly; along/offset within 1e-4 m. Change a value here and BOTH suites go red. Regenerate: scratchpad/gen_section_corridor_fixture.py.

cases.name: midpoint_on_line
cases.description: A point sitting on the line at mid-length is a member with zero offset.

cases.name: far_endpoint_exact
cases.description: A test whose coordinate IS the far endpoint is a member (the 2026-09-06 bug: float noise must not drop it).

cases.name: start_endpoint_exact
cases.description: A test whose coordinate IS the start endpoint is a member.

cases.name: submicron_beyond_far_endpoint
cases.description: Half a micron past the far endpoint, inside the 1 um endpoint tolerance (the 2026-09-06 ruling admits endpoint float-noise) -> member.

cases.name: clearly_beyond_far_endpoint
cases.description: One millimetre past the far endpoint, well outside the 1 um tolerance -> not a member.

cases.name: submicron_before_start
cases.description: Half a micron before the start endpoint, inside the tolerance -> member.

cases.name: clearly_before_start
cases.description: One millimetre before the start endpoint, outside the tolerance -> not a member.

cases.name: inside_buffer_left
cases.description: 18 m to the left of the line, buffer 25 m -> member, positive offset.

cases.name: inside_buffer_right
cases.description: 18 m to the right of the line -> member, negative offset.

cases.name: at_buffer_edge
cases.description: Exactly at the buffer half-width (25 m) -> member (the bound is inclusive).

cases.name: outside_buffer
cases.description: 30 m off the line, buffer 25 m -> not a member.
